verdict.rationale: Firecrawl does LLM-based structured extraction (JSON format with prompt and schema) and is self-hostable under AGPL, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents configuring a local or self-hosted LLM, such as Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, as the extraction backend. A community comment suggesting the project 'add Ollama support' points the same way.
